messages.text: Hello Anuda, this is Nelum from Riverstone Mills in Galle. I am calling about your application for the stores clerk task opening on our work app.
Hello Nelum, thank you for calling. I sent the application last week and I am still interested in the stores clerk post.
The next step is on Monday at 9:00. Open the task screen and note reference RF700.
I can do that. Is there any wallet payment I must send before the work starts?
Before the balance opens you have to transfer LKR 7500 as the VIP level upgrade fee. Until that arrives the LKR 47000 task total stays locked.
Can the company take that from the first salary instead of asking me to send money today?
No. The LKR 7500 has to arrive first, and the receipt must show RF700. Then the screen pays the LKR 47000 balance.
I need to think about sending LKR 7500 before any pay. I will look at the screen again before 9:00 on Monday.
